objective: Make bare /swe list responsive by rendering every full, copyable initiative name on its own line and placing metadata/work detail on a second line without fixed-width table truncation.
constraints: Initiative identifiers must never be truncated.
Remove fixed-width table columns and static 78-column clipping from initiative overview rows.
Keep status, revision, progress, focus, and current/next work visible.
Keep output bounded by the existing 25-initiative limit and bounded work-title summary.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every listed initiative renders its complete canonical identifier on a dedicated first line suitable for direct copying.
A second line renders revision, done progress, status, and current/next work when present without fixed terminal-width padding or clipping.
Focused and terminal initiatives retain correct markers and metadata, and targeted regression tests pass.

assessment.reason: A localized presentation redesign responding to direct usability feedback.
unknowns: The command notification API does not expose chat-pane width, so responsiveness should delegate wrapping to the host renderer.

practices.reason: Full-name preservation and two-line structure are directly testable.
Review copyability, responsive behavior, and compatibility.

obligations.text: Run type checking and targeted pi-swe runtime/docket tests.
Review the renderer and tests for untruncated identifiers, two-line layout, and bounded output.

testing.approach: Assert exact two-line row structure, full long identifiers, metadata ordering, focus markers, and absence of fixed-width truncation.
testing.reason: Directly guards the reported copyability and unused-width problems.

args: npm run typecheck && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/pi-swe-runtime.test.ts test/pi-swe-docket.test.ts

evidence.summary: Model self-review (not independent or human review): confirmed each initiative ID is emitted unchanged as its own logical line, with focus, revision, done progress, status, and optional current/next work on the following line. Fixed-width padding, 78-column clipping, and identifier truncation were removed so the host pane controls wrapping. Discovery remains capped at 25 and work-title detail remains bounded at 140 characters. Tests cover exact long-name preservation, two-line actionable and terminal rows, focus markers, and metadata order. No blocking findings.

decisions.text: Render the full identifier alone on line one and compact metadata plus actionable work on line two, allowing the host UI to wrap naturally.
decisions.basis: The notification API has no pane-width parameter; avoiding fixed-width clipping is the reliable responsive behavior.

risks.text: Very narrow panes may wrap long identifiers.
risks.mitigation: Never truncate the identifier; let the host wrap it while preserving the exact copyable text.

risks.text: Two lines per initiative increase vertical output.
risks.mitigation: Retain the existing 25-initiative bound and keep each initiative to exactly two logical lines.
